init_RealsenseAPI: initialize a RealsenseAPI wrapper to connect to Intel RealSense D435 cameras with configurable resolution and fps
get_rgbd: call get_rgbd on a RealsenseAPI instance to retrieve aligned RGBD frames as a numpy array
get_intrinsics_dict: call get_intrinsics_dict on a RealsenseAPI instance to get camera intrinsics as a dictionary keyed by device ID
get_intrinsics: call get_intrinsics on a RealsenseAPI instance to retrieve raw intrinsics objects for all connected cameras
get_num_cameras: call get_num_cameras on a RealsenseAPI instance to return the count of connected RealSense cameras
